beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus told a story about ten young women waiting for a wedding.

timing.text: Jesus told a story about ten young women waiting for a wedding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In those days, a whole village would wait for the bridegroom to come, late in the evening, and lead everyone in to the feast.

timing.text: In those days, a whole village would wait for the bridegroom to come, late in the evening, and lead everyone in to the feast.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So ten young women took their oil lamps and went out into the dusk to meet him.

timing.text: So ten young women took their oil lamps and went out into the dusk to meet him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Five of them were wise. Along with their lamps, they each carried a small jar of extra oil.

timing.text: Five of them were wise.
Along with their lamps, they each carried a small jar of extra oil.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The other five were foolish. They brought their lamps — but no extra oil at all.

timing.text: The other five were foolish.
They brought their lamps — but no extra oil at all.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The bridegroom was delayed. Hour after hour slipped by, and one by one, all ten women grew drowsy and fell asleep.

timing.text: The bridegroom was delayed.
Hour after hour slipped by, and one by one, all ten women grew drowsy and fell asleep.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

timing.text: Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then, at midnight, a cry rang out: The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!

timing.text: Then, at midnight, a cry rang out: The bridegroom is coming!
Come out to meet him!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They all woke and reached for their lamps. The wise trimmed theirs, and they burned warm and bright.

timing.text: They all woke and reached for their lamps.
The wise trimmed theirs, and they burned warm and bright.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the foolish looked down in dismay. Their lamps were sputtering out — they had no oil left.

timing.text: But the foolish looked down in dismay.
Their lamps were sputtering out — they had no oil left.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

timing.text: Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Please, they cried out to the others — give us some of your oil!

timing.text: Please, they cried out to the others — give us some of your oil!

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

timing.text: Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the wise couldn't. There isn't enough for all of us, they said. Hurry — go and buy your own.

timing.text: But the wise couldn't.
There isn't enough for all of us, they said.
Hurry — go and buy your own.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And while the foolish rushed off into the dark to find oil, the bridegroom arrived.

timing.text: And while the foolish rushed off into the dark to find oil, the bridegroom arrived.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The ones who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast. And the door was shut.

timing.text: The ones who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast.
And the door was shut.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Lord, Lord, open to us.

timing.text: Lord, Lord, open to us.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

timing.text: Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Later the others came back, knocking. Lord, they called, open the door for us! But the answer came from inside: I do not know you.

timing.text: Later the others came back, knocking.
Lord, they called, open the door for us!
But the answer came from inside: I do not know you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then Jesus told them why he had shared this story.

timing.text: Then Jesus told them why he had shared this story.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

timing.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The oil is the one thing you cannot borrow at the last minute — a heart that is truly ready, a faith that is really your own, a lamp you have kept burning.

timing.text: The oil is the one thing you cannot borrow at the last minute — a heart that is truly ready, a faith that is really your own, a lamp you have kept burning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And here is the good news: the door is still open now. Tonight, your lamp can be filled. He is worth being ready for.

timing.text: And here is the good news: the door is still open now.

card.text: You cannot borrow someone else's oil. Is your own lamp burning — are you ready to meet him?
